A short, periodically updated snapshot, in the spirit of [now pages](https://nownownow.com/about).
**Last updated: October 2026.**

## Research

- **Planning cycle networks.** I lead development of the [Network Planning Tool for Scotland](https://www.npt.scot), funded by Transport Scotland and developed with Sustrans, and work on methods for designing core networks, such as [Corenet](/publications/wang-corenet-2026/).
- **Safer routes to school.** With colleagues at the University of Lisbon, the [BICISCHOOLS](https://github.com/bicischools) project develops open methods to plan cycling routes and bike buses to schools.
- **Open mobility data.** Tools such as [spanishoddata](/publications/kotov-spanishoddata-2026/) make large origin-destination datasets usable on a laptop.
- **Road safety and street design.** Recent work includes [outdoor lighting and active travel](/publications/vidal-tortosa-outdoor-lighting-2026/) and [identifying rat-runs](/publications/fonseca-zamora-ratruns-2026/).

See [publications](/publications/) for the full list.

## Open tools

- [Network Planning Tool](https://www.npt.scot) and [Propensity to Cycle Tool](https://www.pct.bike): open tools for planning cycle networks.
- [SaferActive](https://saferactive.github.io): data-driven methods for cyclist and pedestrian safety.
- [Geocomputation with R](https://r.geocompx.org/) and [Geocomputation with Python](https://py.geocompx.org/): free, open-source books on geographic data science.

## Teaching

I lead the [Transport Data Science](https://github.com/ITSLeeds/tds) module at the University of Leeds.

## Collaboration

I welcome conversations about reproducible transport data science, open-source software and evidence for sustainable transport.
